title: API response field renamed
change: The temperature field was removed and temp_c was added.
symptoms: Clients expecting the temperature field may fail.
root_cause: The provider changed its response schema.
verified_repair: After confirming field semantics and units, use a compatibility adapter to expose the expected field to older clients.
verification: Test the adapter against documented units and representative old and new API responses.

title: Authentication header changed
change: The API stopped accepting the previous authentication header.
symptoms: Requests that previously succeeded return unauthorized responses.
root_cause: The provider changed its authentication contract.
verified_repair: Update the authentication adapter only after confirming the new header format in official provider documentation.
verification: Test successful authentication and rejection of invalid credentials.

title: API response type changed
change: A numeric response field changed from a number to a string.
symptoms: Clients performing arithmetic on the field may fail.
root_cause: The response type no longer matches the expected schema.
verified_repair: Add validated type conversion only after confirming the new format and allowed values.
verification: Test valid values, malformed strings, missing fields, and boundary cases.
